CheckTitle: At least one IAM role has the AWSSupportAccess managed policy attached
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Presence of an IAM role that has the AWS managed AWSSupportAccess policy attached, designating a support role for interacting with AWS Support Center.
Risk: Without a dedicated support role, case creation can be delayed and teams may use admin/root, increasing blast radius.

Code.NativeIaC: # CloudFormation: attach AWSSupportAccess to a role
Code.Other: In AWS console, go to IAM > Roles, select a role, Add permissions, search AWSSupportAccess, Attach

Recommendation.Text: Create a dedicated IAM role for AWS Support with AWSSupportAccess and restrict who can assume it.
